name: algenta_query_dataset
description: Use the companion algenta_get_contract tool first to inspect the live machine-readable contract, then discover datasets with lexical search, fetch a low-token dataset summary, and run one governed exact query or a governed exact-query batch against an authorized Algenta dataset. Use this tool for operational facts, KPIs, and time-series questions over connected data.

dataset_search.description: Lexical search hint for dataset discovery. Example: orders, revenue, support.

dataset_id.description: Optional explicit dataset_id. If present, skip search and use this dataset directly.

metric_hint.description: Exact metric hint for a single governed query. Example: completed_order_count.

metric_role.description: Metric role for the single governed query.

aggregation.description: Optional aggregation for the single query.

group_by.description: Optional grouping columns for the single query.

filter.description: Optional governed filter object for the single query.

limit.description: Optional row limit for the single query.

order.description: Optional row order for the single query.

batch_queries.description: Optional governed exact-query batch. If present, the tool uses /v1/query/batch instead of /v1/query.
